ios.desc:
Benect - White Noise with Auto Fade-Out

High-quality ambient sounds that gradually fade as you drift off. Ocean waves, rain, bonfire, temple bells, coffee shop ambiance, and more.
100% free. No ads. No subscriptions.

■ Core Features
- Auto fade-out timer—sounds gradually lower as you fall asleep
- Mix multiple sounds to create your perfect ambiance
- High-quality audio: ocean waves, rain, thunder, bonfire, flowing river, insects
- Ambient scenes: coffee shop, street sounds, temple bells
- Focus sounds: typewriter, wooden fish, white noise
- Music: lazy jazz, Bach classics
- Shortcuts and widgets for quick access

■ Why Fade-Out Matters
Regular sleep apps play sounds at constant volume all night. But as you drift off, even gentle sounds can feel too loud and pull you back awake.

Benect's fade-out timer gradually lowers the volume as you fall asleep—so the sounds are there when you need them, and gone when you don't.

■ Perfect For
- Falling asleep without silence anxiety
- Focusing in noisy environments
- Blocking coffee shop chatter
- Creating a calm study atmosphere
- Meditation and relaxation

■ Pricing
Free. No ads. No in-app purchases. No subscriptions.
We built this for ourselves and wanted to share it.

■ Contact
Questions or suggestions? myfancoo@gmail.com
